text: Entry 1087 extracts the channel URI helper. Accepted CopyMessage, LoadMessage and SaveMessageToDisk all call GetUrlForUri, while already-internal x-moz URLs pass through. The service supports EWS and Graph scheme conversion. The current fragment-to-path/local-key contract is already a shared lesson and must not be replaced with the historical remote EWS-ID URI format.
